mechanism.claim: When the time centroid of completed quote turnover lies materially after the time centroid of realized variation, participation is arriving to sponsor rather than initiate a volatile displacement. At a new upper-tail positive lag with consistent full-block and final-two-hour direction, follow the accepted direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour and final-two-hour BTC returns
mechanism.why_distinct: Daily late-volume continuation uses a terminal calendar bucket, variance backloading uses fixed halves, HVTLRR estimates turnover-to-next-return correlation, and cross-venue torsion compares Spot and perpetual centroids within five-minute buckets. HVTVLR directly compares continuous within-BTC eight-hour turnover and squared-return time centroids and reuses no prior event or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed BTC variation rank must be in its upper 35%, while positive lag requires participation to arrive after the price-energy center
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily turnover-versus-variation timing onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.time_coordinate: minute index divided by 479, from zero through one
features.lag_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns, finite strict positive
features.block_return: log(last close/first open), finite strict nonzero
features.final_two_hour_return: same formula over final 120 completed minutes, finite strict nonzero and same sign as block_return
features.eligible_state: positive lag, lag-rank, variation-rank, and directional agreement gates pass
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no centroid, lag sign, rank, direction, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
